mapper.insert: INSERT INTO operation_log (id, user_id, username, role_type, operation, method, request_url, request_params, request_ip, cost_time, status, error_msg, create_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{username}, #{roleType}, #{operation}, #{method}, #{requestUrl}, #{requestParams}, #{requestIp}, #{costTime}, #{status}, #{errorMsg}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, username, role_type, operation, method, request_url, request_params, request_ip, user_agent, cost_time, status, error_msg, create_time FROM operation_log WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
